messages.content: You are a helpful customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a cloud storage service.
How do I upgrade my plan?

To upgrade your plan, go to Settings > Billing > Change Plan. You can choose from Starter ($9/mo), Pro ($29/mo), or Enterprise (custom pricing). Changes take effect immediately and you'll be charged a prorated amount.
You are a helpful customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a cloud storage service.
I can't upload files larger than 100MB

The 100MB upload limit is specific to the Starter plan. To upload larger files (up to 10GB), please upgrade to the Pro plan. You can do this in Settings > Billing > Change Plan. If you need even larger uploads, our Enterprise plan supports files up to 50GB.
You are a helpful customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a cloud storage service.
How do I share a folder with my team?

To share a folder: 1) Right-click the folder and select 'Share'. 2) Enter the email addresses of your team members. 3) Choose their permission level: Viewer (read-only), Editor (can modify), or Admin (full control). 4) Click 'Send Invite'. Team members will receive an email with a link to access the shared folder.
You are a helpful customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a cloud storage service.
I accidentally deleted an important file. Can I recover it?

Yes! Deleted files are kept in your Trash for 30 days. Go to Trash in the left sidebar, find your file, right-click it, and select 'Restore'. The file will be returned to its original location. If it's been more than 30 days, please contact us at support@acmecloud.com — we may be able to recover it from our backups within 90 days.
You are a helpful customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a cloud storage service.
Is my data encrypted?

Yes, all data on Acme Cloud is encrypted both in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Pro and Enterprise plans also support customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) for additional control. You can manage your encryption settings in Settings > Security > Encryption.
You are a helpful customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a cloud storage service.
What happens if I cancel my subscription?

If you cancel your subscription: 1) Your account will be downgraded to the Free plan at the end of your billing period. 2) You'll retain access to your first 5GB of storage. 3) Files exceeding the Free plan limit will become read-only — you can download them but not upload new files. 4) Shared folders will continue to work for existing collaborators. You can reactivate your plan at any time from Settings > Billing.
You are a helpful customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a cloud storage service.
The desktop app keeps crashing on Windows

Sorry about that! Here are some steps to fix desktop app crashes on Windows: 1) Make sure you're running the latest version — go to Help > Check for Updates. 2) Clear the app cache: close the app, delete the folder at %AppData%/AcmeCloud/cache, then restart. 3) If that doesn't help, try reinstalling from acmecloud.com/download. If the issue persists, please send us the crash log from Help > Export Logs so we can investigate further.
You are a helpful customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a cloud storage service.
Can I use Acme Cloud with my custom domain?

Custom domains are available on the Enterprise plan. You can configure a custom domain (e.g., files.yourcompany.com) in Settings > Organization > Custom Domain. We'll guide you through adding the required DNS records. The setup typically takes 15-30 minutes, and we provide a free SSL certificate via Let's Encrypt.
You are a helpful customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a cloud storage service.
How do I enable two-factor authentication?

To enable 2FA: 1) Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. 2) Click 'Enable'. 3) Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.). 4) Enter the 6-digit code to verify. 5) Save the backup codes in a safe place — you'll need them if you lose access to your authenticator app. 2FA is required for all Enterprise accounts and strongly recommended for all users.
You are a helpful customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a cloud storage service.
How much storage do I get on the free plan?

The Free plan includes 5GB of storage with up to 100MB per file upload. You also get basic sharing (up to 3 collaborators per folder) and 30-day trash retention. For more storage and features, check out our Starter plan (100GB, $9/mo) or Pro plan (1TB, $29/mo) at acmecloud.com/pricing.

If it's been more than 30 days, please contact us at support@acmecloud.com — we may be able to recover it from our backups within 90 days.

Is my data encrypted?

Yes, all data on Acme Cloud is encrypted both in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Pro and Enterprise plans also support customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) for additional control. You can manage your encryption settings in Settings > Security > Encryption.

What happens if I cancel my subscription?

If you cancel your subscription: 1) Your account will be downgraded to the Free plan at the end of your billing period. 2) You'll retain access to your first 5GB of storage. 3) Files exceeding the Free plan limit will become read-only — you can download them but not upload new files. 4) Shared folders will continue to work for existing collaborators. You can reactivate your plan at any time from Settings > Billing.

How do I enable two-factor authentication?

To enable 2FA: 1) Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. 2) Click 'Enable'. 3) Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.). 4) Enter the 6-digit code to verify. 5) Save the backup codes in a safe place — you'll need them if you lose access to your authenticator app. 2FA is required for all Enterprise accounts and strongly recommended for all users.
